title: Paint the Dungeon Gray
description: Paint the Dungeon Gray — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Sir Kent says that the dungeon is getting old and needs touchups in places. Collect the following things from enemies in Algernon

  • 7 cans of gray paint, by killing Whiskers on Levels 1 and 2

Quest Reward: 750 Gold + 1 KC

Return to: Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No
